brief.headline: Push for a 2–3% price reduction on rigid plastic packaging, backed by their 7.4% net margin versus 5.0% peer median and our access to four credible alternates.

priceAsk.summary: Request a 2–3% price reduction on all rigid plastic packaging SKUs
priceAsk.target: Target saving of ₹0.80 L to ₹1.20 L annually on our ₹39.99 L spend
priceAsk.basis: PGP Glass earns 7.4% net margin against a 5.0% peer median — 240 basis points of headroom. HDPE resin import unit value stands at 87.61 ₹/kg, giving us a market reference point. With four alternates ready to quote, we have competitive leverage to close the gap.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Extend payment terms from 30 Days After Receipt to 45 Days After Receipt
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: Freeing ₹3.29 L in working capital at current 30-day terms; an additional 15 days would release another ₹1.64 L

brief.financialLeverage: PGP Glass is financially strong — CARE A+ / Stable rating, ₹3373.51 Cr revenue, 28.7% EBITDA margin, and 7.4% net margin (vs 5.0% peer median). Debt-to-equity of 0.70x and interest coverage of 2.84x are comfortable. However, we represent only 0.01% of their revenue (₹39.99 L spend), so our standalone pull is weak. The margin cushion and investment-grade rating mean we can push hard on price and terms without continuity risk, but we must leverage competition and volume commitments to gain traction. Two risk flags — EPF payment delays and pending legal cases — suggest operational friction, though the B health score (62/100) and solid rating keep counterparty risk low.

evidence.point: PGP Glass runs a net margin 240 basis points above peer median
Their EBITDA margin is strong at nearly 29%
We are a negligible customer in their book
Investment-grade credit rating indicates low default risk
Their cash conversion cycle is slower than peers
evidence.figure: 78d cash conversion cycle vs 71d peer median

evidence.point: HDPE resin import benchmark provides a raw-material reference

alternates.name: Manjushree Technopack Ltd
alternates.why: India's largest rigid-plastic packaging converter with pharma bottles, caps, and preforms capability — top second-source candidate

alternates.name: Mold-Tek Packaging Ltd
alternates.role: Listed rigid-plastic leader for pails, containers, and pharma with A health score — robust alternate for bottles and closures

alternates.name: Hitech Corporation Ltd
alternates.why: Listed moulded and blow-moulded packaging supplier with broad capability across bottles and caps

risks: At 0.01% of their revenue, we lack standalone bargaining power — must bundle volume, extend contract term, or run a live RFQ to create urgency
EPF payment delays and pending legal cases (risk flags) hint at operational or compliance issues; monitor delivery reliability closely
Their 29d payable days are well below the 42d peer median, suggesting they squeeze their own suppliers — less room to absorb our payment-term extension without friction
No internal best-price benchmark for rigid plastic packaging limits our ability to cite a concrete SKU-level gap; rely on margin delta and market resin price instead
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We value the partnership, but with your 7.4% margin running well above the 5.0% peer median and four qualified alternates ready to quote, we'd like to discuss a 2–3% price reduction and a move to 45-day terms.
